description: Repairs r-err-1b/arg-percentposition-150: the assignment returned success and nothing was read back (position, rows), so whether it moved the cursor or did nothing was not observed. On a NEW dynaset over Q (two rows) and then on another after MoveLast: read PercentPosition, AbsolutePosition, RecordCount and the ID; put PercentPosition R4 150; read Errors; read PercentPosition, AbsolutePosition, RecordCount, BOF, EOF, EditMode and the ID; close. Asks what an out-of-range PercentPosition does to the position and rows, before and after the recordset is populated. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
